hero.title: Please read these terms carefully
hero.p1: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the Ghost Chat mobile application, website, and related communication services.
hero.p2: By downloading, installing, or using the Ghost Chat application, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms.
hero.p3: If you do not agree with these Terms, you should discontinue use of the Service.

sections.title: 1. Definitions
paragraphs: "Ghost Chat" refers to the messaging platform, mobile application, and associated services operated under this name.
"User" refers to any individual who downloads, registers, or interacts with the Service.
"Content" refers to messages, images, videos, profile information, and other data shared through the platform.

sections.title: 2. Introduction
paragraphs: Ghost Chat provides a communication platform that allows users to send messages, share media, and interact with other users.
The Service aims to provide a safe and efficient messaging experience while encouraging respectful and responsible communication.

sections.title: 3. Eligibility
items: You must be at least 10 years old to use the Service.
You agree to comply with all applicable laws and regulations.
You must have the legal authority to accept these Terms.

sections.title: 4. User Accounts
paragraphs: To access certain features, users must create an account. You agree to provide accurate and up-to-date information.

sections.title: 5. Description of the Service
paragraphs: Ghost Chat is a communication platform designed to help users connect and communicate with others in real time.
The services provided by Ghost Chat may include, but are not limited to:
items: Sharing of images, media files, and other content
sections.footer: Ghost Chat acts only as a platform for communication and does not control, monitor, or guarantee the actions, behavior, or content shared by users.

hero.title: Your privacy matters to us
hero.p1: Ghost Chat ("we", "our", or "us") values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use the Ghost Chat mobile application and related services.
hero.p2: By downloading, accessing, or using Ghost Chat, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
paragraphs: We may collect several types of information to provide and improve our services:

items.text: Phone number, email address, or login credentials used to create an account.
Username, profile photo, biography, and other details you voluntarily provide.
Messages, images, audio files, videos, call logs, and other media shared between users through messaging, voice calls.
Device model, operating system version, device identifiers, and app version.
Information about how the application is used, including feature interactions.
Technical logs such as IP address, crash reports, diagnostics, and performance metrics.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: Your information may be used for the following purposes:
items: Providing messaging, voice calling communication services
Ensuring security and preventing abuse or fraud
Providing customer support and technical assistance
Analyzing user experience to enhance features

sections.title: 3. Communication Privacy
paragraphs: Ghost Chat is designed to support private communication between users, including text messaging and voice calls.
Communication data may be transmitted through secure technologies to enable real-time interaction between users.
While we implement security measures to protect communication data, no digital system can guarantee absolute security. Users should exercise caution when sharing sensitive information.

sections.title: 4. Data Storage and Retention
paragraphs: We retain personal information only as long as necessary to provide services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements.
Some information may remain temporarily in backups or logs for operational and security purposes.

sections.title: 5. Data Security
paragraphs: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.
Security measures include encrypted communication, secure servers, and access control systems.

sections.title: 6. Third-Party Services
paragraphs: Ghost Chat may rely on trusted third-party services to operate and improve the platform.
sections.footer: These providers process data only as necessary to deliver their services.

sections.title: 7. User Rights and Choices
paragraphs: Users have rights regarding their personal data, including:
sections.footer: Users may modify profile information or delete their account through the application settings.

sections.title: 8. Children's Privacy
paragraphs: Ghost Chat is not intended for children under the age of 10. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
If such information is discovered, we will promptly remove it.

sections.title: 9. Changes to This Privacy Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in services, technology, or legal requirements.
Updated versions will include a revised effective date.

sections.title: 10. Governing Law
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy shall be governed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of India.
